name: Channel Divinity
uses: Refill on short or long rest
description: Channel Divinity powers Turn Undead and the effects your domain gives you. Each effect costs 1 use. Effects that call for a save use your spell save DC.
Short or long rests restore all your uses.

name: Turn Undead
description: Action: raise your holy symbol and pray against the undead. Every undead within 30 ft that can see or hear you rolls a Wisdom save. Failing means it is turned for 1 minute, ending early if it takes damage.

A turned undead runs from you as far as it can, never choosing to step within 30 ft of you, and cannot react. On its turn it may only Dash, try to break free of a restraint, or Dodge if it has nowhere to run.
From level 5, an undead that fails the save is destroyed if its CR is at or below the value shown.

name: Divine Intervention
uses: Once per long rest (7 days after success)
description: Action: describe the help you ask your deity for, then roll percentile dice. If the roll is no higher than your cleric level, the deity steps in and the DM picks the effect (any cleric or domain spell effect fits).
If it works, you cannot use this again for 7 days. If it fails, you can try again after a long rest. At level 20 it works automatically with no roll.

name: Knowledge of the Ages
description: Pick one skill or tool. You are proficient with it for 10 minutes.

name: Read Thoughts
description: Target a creature you can see within 60 ft. It makes a Wisdom save. On a pass, you cannot target it with this again until a long rest.

On a fail, you read its surface thoughts for 1 minute while it stays within 60 ft of you. During that time you can spend your action to end the reading and cast suggestion on it with no spell slot. It automatically fails the save against that spell.

name: Visions of the Past
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Meditate for at least 1 minute while holding an object or standing in a place, and you receive glimpses of its recent history. You can keep it up for as many minutes as your Wisdom score, and you must concentrate throughout.
Object Reading: learn how the last owner got and lost the item, plus the latest big event involving them. Each extra minute covers one earlier owner, back as many days as your Wisdom score.
Area Reading: see events in a space up to a 50-ft cube, one significant event per minute, newest first, going back as many days as your Wisdom score.

name: Preserve Life
description: Present your holy symbol and spread a pool of healing among creatures within 30 ft of you. The pool equals 5 times your cleric level.
This cannot raise anyone above half of their hit point maximum, and it does not work on undead or constructs.

name: Divine Strike
trigger: You hit with a weapon attack
description: Once on each of your turns, when a weapon attack hits, you can add 1d8 radiant damage to it. The extra damage becomes 2d8 at cleric level 14.
It costs no action and no resource; just declare it when you hit.

name: Warding Flare
trigger: A creature you can see within 30 ft attacks you
description: When a creature within 30 ft that you can see attacks you, flare light at it so the attack roll has disadvantage. Attackers that cannot be blinded ignore this.

name: Radiance of the Dawn
description: Present your holy symbol. Magical darkness within 30 ft of you ends, and every hostile creature within 30 ft makes a Constitution save.
A failed save takes 2d10 + your cleric level radiant damage; a pass takes half. Targets with total cover from you are unaffected.

name: Improved Flare
trigger: A creature within 30 ft attacks someone else
description: Warding Flare now also protects others: use it when a creature you can see within 30 ft attacks someone other than you.

name: Corona of Light
description: Activate an aura of sunlight lasting 1 minute, or until you end it with another action. It sheds bright light in a 60-ft radius and dim light for 30 ft more.
Enemies standing in the bright light have disadvantage on saves against your fire or radiant spells.

name: Charm Animals and Plants
description: Present your holy symbol and name your deity. Each beast or plant creature within 30 ft that can see you makes a Wisdom save.
A creature that fails becomes your charmed friend (and a friend to anyone you name). The charm lasts 1 minute and breaks the moment it takes damage.

name: Dampen Elements
trigger: A creature within 30 ft takes acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage
description: When you or a creature within 30 ft takes acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage, grant that creature resistance to that single instance of damage.

name: Divine Strike
trigger: You hit with a weapon attack
description: Once on each of your turns, when a weapon attack hits, you can add 1d8 cold, fire or lightning (your choice) damage to it. The extra damage becomes 2d8 at cleric level 14.
It costs no action and no resource; just declare it when you hit.

name: Master of Nature
description: While creatures are charmed by Charm Animals and Plants, use a bonus action on your turn to tell each what to do on its next turn.

name: Wrath of the Storm
trigger: A creature within 5 ft hits you
description: A creature you can see that is within 5 ft and hits you must make a Dexterity save. Choose lightning or thunder: it takes 2d8 of that type, or half if it passes.

name: Destructive Wrath
trigger: You roll lightning or thunder damage
description: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, spend a Channel Divinity use to take the maximum on each die instead of rolling.

name: Thunderbolt Strike
description: Lightning damage you deal to a creature of size Large or smaller can also push it up to 10 ft away from you.

name: Divine Strike
trigger: You hit with a weapon attack
description: Once on each of your turns, when a weapon attack hits, you can add 1d8 thunder damage to it. The extra damage becomes 2d8 at cleric level 14.
It costs no action and no resource; just declare it when you hit.

name: Blessing of the Trickster
description: Touch someone willing (not yourself) to make their Dexterity (Stealth) checks advantaged for 1 hour. Using this again ends the earlier blessing.

name: Invoke Duplicity
description: Make an illusory copy of yourself in an open space you can see within 30 ft. It lasts 1 minute and ends if you lose concentration.
As a bonus action, move it up to 30 ft to a space you can see, keeping it within 120 ft of you. You can cast spells as if standing in its space, using your own senses.
When you and the copy are both within 5 ft of a creature that can see the copy, you have advantage on attacks against that creature.

name: Cloak of Shadows
description: You turn invisible until the end of your next turn. You become visible early if you attack or cast a spell.

name: Divine Strike
trigger: You hit with a weapon attack
description: Once on each of your turns, when a weapon attack hits, you can add 1d8 poison damage to it. The extra damage becomes 2d8 at cleric level 14.
It costs no action and no resource; just declare it when you hit.

name: Improved Duplicity
description: Invoke Duplicity makes up to 4 copies instead of 1. On your turn, spend a bonus action to shift any of them up to 30 ft each, never farther than 120 ft from you.

name: War Priest
description: When you take the Attack action, make 1 weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Guided Strike
description: When you make an attack roll, spend a Channel Divinity use for a +10 bonus to it. Decide after seeing the roll, before the DM says if it hits.

name: War God's Blessing
trigger: A creature within 30 ft makes an attack roll
description: When a creature within 30 ft makes an attack roll, spend a Channel Divinity use to give it a +10 bonus. Decide after seeing the roll, before the DM says if it hits.

name: Divine Strike
trigger: You hit with a weapon attack
description: Once on each of your turns, when a weapon attack hits, you can add 1d8 bonus (same type as your weapon) damage to it. The extra damage becomes 2d8 at cleric level 14.
It costs no action and no resource; just declare it when you hit.
